title: How to Focus on your Goal? By Sandeep Maheshwari I Hindi
description: "Think about what's really important to you in life. Make that your priority."  Sandeep Maheshwari is a name among millions who struggled, failed and surged ahead in search of success, happiness and contentment. Just like any middle class guy, he too had a bunch of unclear dreams and a blurred vision of his goals in life. All he had was an undying learning attitude to hold on to. Rowing through ups and downs, it was time that taught him the true meaning of his life.  To know more, log on to www.sandeepmaheshwari.com Connect with him at Facebook.com/SandeepMaheshwariPage Watch his inspirational videos at Youtube.com/SandeepSeminars  Music: Youtube Music Library

potential_elements.text: How to Focus on your Goal? By Sandeep Maheshwari I Hindi

"Think about what's really important to you in life. Make that your priority."
